evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'I'm not really worried about the price, just kinda want to get it done.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Only the generic actual-hours-billed framing landed; no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Handled a mid-call audio dropout gracefully, patiently re-establishing the connection without losing the thread or the customer's trust, and answered a junk-removal question honestly even though it cost a potential upsell.
coaching_note: Meet Your Mover landed but damage coverage and the On-Time Guarantee never got mentioned; the close also never got a formal ask — the customer self-closed early ('sign me up, I'm ready') and the rep rode that momentum rather than confirming with an explicit close question afterward.
